verdict.rationale: Orama Cloud is a managed search/RAG platform, so scheduled jobs such as recurring data-source syncs or re-indexing are a fair question to ask, and the axis applies. The pack contains no evidence of a scheduler, cron, or recurring-workflow feature. The 'different update schedule' line (orama-docs-22) only advises how to split data sources by how often the user updates them. The JavaScript runtime for agents and business logic (orama-docs-46) says nothing about scheduling.
